svg.title: Ananya replaces one treatment card with another after reviewing the result.
svg.desc: Ananya's hands move the prior medicine card aside and place a corrected card forward without destroying the old record. Her watch shows there is still time to begin the new treatment today.
svg.text: Page 30, panel 2 · Close-up on Ananya's hands changing a treatment plan

text.tspan: Ananya changes the treatment on the strength of the
timely result while preserving the prior record.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
